title: Markdown Tasks Power the 3-Way Review from Spec to PR | Alex Gavrilescu, Funstage
description:
This is a teaser for Alex Gavrilescu’s full workshop at AI Native DevCon Fall, Nov 18–19.

Backlog.md was built 99% by AI agents — with humans guiding vision and reviewing work. In this hands-on session, Alex walks through how markdown specs in your repo can streamline collaboration between humans and agents, and why this simple workflow helped Backlog.md surpass 3,000+ GitHub stars.

You’ll learn the “3-way review” loop — spec, plan, and code — that keeps humans in control while letting agents handle the heavy lifting. Participants will install Backlog.md, initialize it in a new or existing repo, and use their preferred coding agent to create and ship a task end-to-end.

In the full DevCon workshop, you’ll learn:
- Why specs-as-markdown work out of the box for agents
- How the 3-way review process ensures high-quality AI-assisted shipping
- How to integrate Backlog.md into your development workflow

About the speaker:
Alex Gavrilescu is Lead Backend and Web Developer at Funstage GmbH in Vienna, where he helps keep millions of free-to-play gamers happily tapping. A hands-on engineer who still ships code, he experiments with Raspberry Pi Kubernetes clusters in his spare time and explores how AI can make project management simpler and smarter. He’s also the creator of Backlog.md, a micro-tool that turns side-project chaos into shippable tasks.
